name: Drawer Container
description: Upstream-parity drawer/sheet chrome (AxisSize algebra, DrawerRawContainer, SheetRawContainer, DrawerContainerData, DrawerContainer, SheetContainer) for pinned sheets and drawer overlays.

use: you build pinned sheets or custom drawer chrome around content.
you need cross-axis sizing algebra for sheets.

examples.minimal:
DrawerContainerData(
  position: OverlayPosition.bottom,
  size: Size.zero,
  stackIndex: 0,
  child: DrawerContainer(child: Text('Sheet')),
)

theming: Uses `Theme.of(context)` border, background, and radius tokens.
accessibility: Provide a visible drag handle label when sheets are draggable.
do: Read configuration via `DrawerContainerData` for data-driven sheets.
dont: Own drag gestures inside the raw container; wrap it instead.
